title: ruling-door-supersede-path
intention: Give the ruling door a way to retire a MISFILED packet without editing a confirmed record of truth in place.
why: Found by first real use, 2026-08-02. CC misused what_dies (which means the path CEASES TO EXIST) to mean 'the stale claim inside this file dies'; verify caught it in thirty seconds, exactly as designed. But there is no supersede path: open_ruling rewrites the same id with confirmed:false, which would ERASE Akien's act, so the corrected packet had to take a new id and the misfiled one stays on disk, permanently red. The Stop hook now reports it every single turn. A permanent red is noise, and noise gets trained away while still LOOKING like coverage — the same failure this system names elsewhere as coin-toss-red. NOT structural by the 2026-08-02 test: editing lines of code fixes it.
traces_to: Law 7 — errors loud and permanent in records of truth: a misfiled packet must be retired without editing the confirmed record
